original.description: The Binoculars paper's reference pair and the thresholds derived for it. Calibrated: reports state a verdict.

latest.description: Current-generation equivalents (Qwen3.5, 2026). No published thresholds exist for this pair, so reports give no verdict; they show where the text falls relative to the control samples. Measured in October 2026 to separate the controls less well than the original pair; kept as a worked example, not a recommendation.
